activation_days.definition: Median days from won date (close_date of the account's first won opportunity) to its first succeeded transaction, for accounts won in calendar 2025 that have transacted.

dispute_return_rate.definition: Disputes plus returns opened in the golden month / succeeded transactions in the golden month.

failure_rate.definition: Failed / all transactions (any status) in the golden month.

gross_revenue_retention.definition: As NRR, but each account's golden-month revenue is capped at its revenue 12 months earlier.

lead_to_opp_conversion.definition: Share of leads created in calendar 2025 (UTC) that have converted_at set.

logo_churn_contract.definition: Accounts live by 2025-10-31 and not contract-churned by then, whose subscription ended in the trailing 12 months, as a share of those accounts.

logo_churn_silent.definition: Live accounts with no contract end whose last succeeded transaction is on or before 2026-09-01 (60 days before the as-of date).

net_revenue_12m_per_account_by_lead_sour.definition: For accounts that went live inside the data window and on or before 2025-10-31: net revenue in their first 12 calendar months from the go-live month; the median per account, by the lead source of the account's first won opportunity (missing -> unknown). Median, not mean, so one very large account cannot decide the comparison.

net_revenue_retention.definition: Net revenue in the golden month from accounts live (went_live_at) on or before the end of the month 12 months earlier, divided by those accounts' net revenue in that earlier month. Churned accounts count as zero; reactivated accounts count.

net_revenue_usd.definition: Platform fee (invoice lines for the month) + usage fee (succeeded USD volume x fee_bps effective on the transaction date) + FX margin (cross-currency succeeded USD volume x fx_margin_bps) + minimum-commit true-up (invoice lines whose period is the month), golden month.

pipeline_created_usd.definition: Sum of amount_usd of opportunities created in the golden month (null amounts excluded).

platform_mrr_usd.definition: Sum of platform-fee invoice lines whose period is the golden month.

revenue_at_risk_usd.definition: Accounts live before 2026-06-01 and not contract-churned by the end of the golden month are at risk if golden-month volume < 0.5 x their average monthly volume over the previous 3 months, or golden-month failure rate > 0.1 on at least 20 transactions. Revenue at risk = their average monthly net revenue over those 3 months.

sales_cycle_days.definition: Median days from created_at (UTC date) to close_date for won opportunities closed in the trailing 12 months, excluding rows whose close_date is before their created date.

sales_velocity_usd_per_day.definition: open opportunities x average won amount_usd (trailing 12 months) x win_rate / sales_cycle_days, as of 2026-10-31.

top10_revenue_concentration.definition: Share of trailing-12-month net revenue earned from the 10 accounts with the most.

total_payment_volume_usd.definition: Sum of succeeded transaction amounts in USD (amount / FX rate of the source currency on the transaction's UTC date) in the golden month.

win_rate.definition: Won / closed (won + lost) opportunities with close_date in the trailing 12 months (2025-11-01..2026-10-31).
